title: Diff Viewer
purpose: Side-by-side or inline diff editor showing changes with optional review annotations
states: annotated - showing review comments on lines
focused - focused on specific change range
acceptance: shall display original on left and modified on right
shall highlight added lines in green
shall highlight removed lines in red
shall support toggling between side-by-side and inline views
shall allow clicking margin to add review comments
shall display review comment glyphs on annotated lines
shall support scrolling with line decorations visible
